title: Invio Plus — Desktop Invoicing Software
description: Invio Plus by Timrio is a privacy-first desktop invoicing and inventory management software for Windows and macOS. Features automated GST calculations (CGST, SGST, IGST), 58mm and 80mm thermal receipt printing with dynamic UPI payment QR codes, barcode scanner checkout, WhatsApp and email invoice dispatch, customer POS display, and 100% offline local SQLite storage.
